entries.explicitly_unused_scope: scanned pages, bitmap OCR, layout detection, table/figure recognition, formula recognition
entries.cpu_behavior: CPU-capable; pure Rust/C++ parser, no model inference
entries.known_risks: only born-digital/programmatic PDFs; scanned pages get weak/no text layer and must fall back to visual backend
entries.upgrade_strategy: pin exact version in benchmark/optional dependency; re-run native baseline + hash on bump

entries.official_interface_used: from paddleocr import PaddleOCRVL; pipeline = PaddleOCRVL(pipeline_version='v1.6'); pipeline.predict(image); res.save_to_json()/save_to_markdown()
entries.explicitly_unused_scope: chart recognition (off by default; out of D-10 phase-1 scope), plot digitization, curve recovery, scatter-point recovery, human parse revision
entries.cpu_behavior: CPU fallback supported (DEVICE = cuda if available else cpu)
entries.network_behavior: downloads model weights from BCE Bos / HuggingFace on first use
entries.model_download_behavior: downloads PaddleOCR-VL-1.6-0.9B weights on first inference; caches under PaddleOCR model cache dir
entries.cache_behavior: caches weights under PaddleOCR model cache; offline requires pre-populated cache
entries.known_risks: heavyweight (PaddlePaddle + model download); not a core startup dependency; chart recognition must stay off; D-10 freezes contract only, real hybrid run is D-11
entries.upgrade_strategy: pin exact paddleocr version and model revision in D-11 adapter; verify license NOTICE/attribution; re-run benchmark on model bump
